title: Justin Fields could be first QB with four straight Week 1 starts for four different teams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Justin Fields could be first QB with four straight Week 1 starts for four different teams
sources.description: If Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes, who tore an ACL last December, isn't ready for the first week of the 2026 regular season, his new backup will make a very specific type of history.
